props.name: hideCaption
props.doc: Keep the caption for assistive tech only.

props.name: rowKey
props.doc: Stable row id — a field name or a function.

props.name: loading
props.doc: Skeleton rows; pagination is disabled while loading.

props.name: error
props.doc: Replaces the table with an ErrorState.

props.name: emptyState
props.doc: Shown when there is no data and no active search/filter.

props.name: noResultsState
props.doc: Shown when search/filters match nothing.

props.name: filterBar
props.doc: Renders a FilterBar above the table.

props.name: filterFn
props.doc: Client mode: custom row predicate (default: search over visible columns, filters match row[filter.id]).

props.name: pagination
props.doc: Server-side paging object, false for no paging, or omit for client paging.

props.name: defaultPageSize
props.doc: Client paging.

props.name: pageSizeOptions
props.doc: Client paging.

props.name: paginationAriaLabel
props.doc: Name of the pagination landmark.

props.name: selectable
props.doc: Checkbox column + bulk action bar.

props.name: selectedRowKeys
props.doc: Controlled selection (all pages).

props.name: preserveSelectionOnFilter
props.doc: Keep the selection when search / filters change.

props.name: columnVisibility
props.doc: true → column menu with internal state (seeded from column.hidden).

props.name: exportCsv
props.doc: Client-side CSV of the visible, exportable columns (client: every filtered row; server: data).

props.name: toolbarRight
props.doc: Extra toolbar content (right side).

props.name: onSortChange
props.doc: Sort changes from header clicks.

props.name: className
props.doc: Class on the DataTable root.

props.name: tableClassName
props.doc: Class on the inner <table> (Table's className).

props.name: selectionMode
props.doc: Selection mode: none, single (radio), multiple (checkbox)

props.name: onRowSelect
props.doc: Legacy: single selection callback

props.name: onRowClick
props.doc: Click row handler

props.name: expandable
props.type: { expandedRowRender: (row: T, index: number) => React.ReactNode; expandedRowKeys?: string…
props.doc: Expandable: render expanded content

props.name: searchable
props.doc: Search

props.name: searchProps
props.doc: Search input props (placeholder, size, showClearButton, etc.)

props.name: searchColumns
props.doc: Search in specific columns only (keys).

props.name: toolbar
props.doc: Custom toolbar slot (replaces search bar when provided)

props.name: toolbarLeft
props.doc: Left slot in toolbar (search + filters)

props.name: loadingVariant
props.doc: Loading UI mode: overlay spinner/text or skeleton rows

props.name: loadingRows
props.doc: Skeleton row count (used when loadingVariant="skeleton")

props.name: emptyText
props.doc: Empty state when no data

props.name: emptyComponent
props.doc: Custom empty component

props.name: striped
props.doc: Striped rows

props.name: bordered
props.doc: Bordered cells

props.name: verticalDivider
props.doc: Show vertical separators between table columns

props.name: hover
props.doc: Row hover effect

props.name: compact
props.doc: Compact padding

props.name: headerColor
props.doc: Header background

props.name: stickyHeader
props.doc: Sticky header (scroll body, fixed header)

props.name: scroll
props.type: { y?: number | string; x?: number | string }
props.doc: Max height for scrollable body (enables sticky header)

props.name: footer
props.doc: Footer/summary row

props.name: showSearch
props.doc: Show/hide search (default true when searchable)

props.name: size
props.doc: Size

props.name: tableLayout
props.doc: Table layout: auto (flexible) vs fixed (fixed column widths)

props.name: variant
props.doc: Visual variant

props.name: theme
props.doc: Theme for light/dark backgrounds.

props.name: value
props.doc: Controlled value.

props.name: onChange
props.doc: Called with the next full value (search is debounced, filters are immediate).

props.name: searchable
props.doc: Render the search field.

props.name: searchDebounceMs
props.doc: Debounce for value.search updates; clearing and Enter commit immediately.

props.name: resultCount
props.doc: Announced in a polite live region ("24 results").

props.name: extra
props.doc: Right-aligned slot (view toggle, export, column menu…).

props.name: maxInlineFilters
props.doc: Filters shown inline before the rest move into the "More filters" popover.

props.name: moreFilters
props.doc: Collapse overflow (and every filter at ≤ 768px) into a popover.

props.name: showLabels
props.doc: Show visible labels above inline controls (otherwise the label is the accessible name + placeholder).

props.name: labels
props.doc: Override any user-facing string.

props.name: stacked
props.doc: Stack all series on the left axis (yAxis: "right" is ignored while stacked).

props.type: { top?: number; right?: number; bottom?: number; left?: number }
